title: Differentials of a standard smooth algebra are free of rank n-c
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring and $A$ an $R$-algebra with a standard smooth presentation [def-weil-pbc-standard-smooth-algebra]: integers $n\ge c\ge0$, $f_1,\dots,f_c\in R[x_1,\dots,x_n]$ and an isomorphism of $R$-algebras $\alpha:R[x_1,\dots,x_n]/(f_1,\dots,f_c)\xrightarrow{\sim}A$ under which $\det(\partial f_j/\partial x_i)_{1\le i,j\le c}$ maps to a unit of $A$. Let $a_i\in A$ be the image of $x_i$. Then the $A$-module of Kähler differentials $\Omega_{A/R}$ [def-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials] is free with basis $\mathrm da_{c+1},\dots,\mathrm da_n$; in particular it is free of rank $n-c$ (of rank $n-c$ in the sense that it is isomorphic to $A^{n-c}$).
